original_card.question: What explicit uniform stock envelope does the actual selected stopped producer supply at one bootstrap stage?
methods: Derive a source-bound reserve recurrence at the actual selected atom widths, separating parent stock from completed inner borrowing.
Find an exact missing implication or counterexample to a proposed selected-stage stock envelope.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Bind every coefficient and depth factor to the selected producer and state the width domain. Compare a proved envelope with the sufficient cutoff guard; a large numerical headroom or a historical m=120 coefficient is not a selected m=73 proof.

first_step.inspect: Read #2972 stock-margin chain and the selected stock audit. The new source archive reports the remaining cutoff comparisons, but leaves every actual stock coefficient unresolved; it is not an independently validated reserve envelope.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only. Read the named package and review before relying on its local evidence; this command is not its replay or supplier admission.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one actual selected producer/stage and derive its parent reserve and depth coefficient from source. Check whether newer handoffs already cover that exact obligation. Stop with the missing implementation lemma if it cannot be bounded; do not rerun #2972 cutoff/headroom arithmetic as a new contribution.
original_card.bottleneck_link: This reduces a concrete inherited implementation obligation without confusing unchanged kappa arithmetic with a completed theorem.
allowed_variations: One stage or one explicit reserve/depth implication.
An independently checked same-domain proof repair, retaining all remaining assumptions.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the historical 57604 or 252 allowance without a selected-producer binding.
Calling a conditional fit lemma a full outer-proof adoption.
Replacing an actual selected stock coefficient with cutoff comparisons or a conditional fit inequality.

existing_checks.scope: Retained stock audit identifies missing actual selected-stage coefficients; later cutoff-chain arithmetic does not supply them.
existing_checks.remaining: Derive one actual reserve/depth coefficient from the selected producer.

actual_scope: For the selected m=73 complex stopped producer, realize the completed ordinary-leaf interface on one complex leaf-call class disjoint from the deferred peeled residual: the high-part exchange of notes/three-stage-cover-rows.tex (one ordinary width-k interchange of H_hi with D_hi after the body wrapper, bodies and Z as spectators). Bind the call plan and exact before/after widths (full-chunk k+body versus high-part k; call count 1) to source, execute through the published completed ordinary engine with the parent leaf reserve as a preceding spectator, and show that this class needs no external leaf reserve (S_leaf = 1). Leave peeled residuals, fixed cover routing, residual-digit adapters, global rho, A, B and the finite-stock-as-C admission to others.
scope_change_reason: #3113 left rho unbound and #3421 left it open after A=0. Citation-only rho=0 and the peeled-atom residual realization were deferred (weak maintainer need / soft overlap). The peeled package's open question named high-part exchange as the next class. This package answers that realization step on a different residual/call class, with exact width costs a maintainer can check without recomputing A or B.
bottleneck_link: The selected kappa binds through the m=73 complex producer. sigma <= (43/26)*(1-s)*(A+B) + rho needs an actual leaf-reserve binding; realizing the high-part-exchange calls removes one of the four leaf-call classes named by PR185 from the unrealized set without changing kappa arithmetic.
stop_rule: Stop after the exact (k,body) plan with before/after widths, physical execution of the high-part exchange through the published completed ordinary engine (elementary and fitted branches) with parent reserve extents 1 and >1, four mutation controls and an independent replay. Do not claim global rho=0, do not realize peeled/routing/adapter calls, do not recompute A=0 or B_bits=2642, do not substitute 252 or 57604, and do not claim a new kappa.
evidence: verify.py (PASS_SELECTED_COMPLEX_HIGHPART_LEAF) re-hashes 25 pinned inputs including every importable file of research/physical-ordinary-interchange before importing it, checks source citations, replays the exact high-part plan on the 5x5 (k,body) grid (one call, active width k, full-chunk width k+body, ratios 2/1..6/1, reserve never active), executes 12 physical cases (q=2,3,5; (k,body) in {(1,1),(1,2),(2,1)}; reserve extents 1 and 3) through the unchanged completed binary interface with per-column provenance and exact before/after widths, and rejects four controls. verify.py --suite fitted runs one high-part exchange through the fitted internally-borrowing branch: C0 returns every column with its parent-reserve coordinate, and the fresh-row padding ratio 3/2 (own rows 8 -> 12) is independent of reserve extent. independent.py recomputes the plan and all engine payload hashes without importing the engine. No new kappa (0.001672660197076918).
author: Wentao Li
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for source reading, plan derivation, engine harness and verifier construction, controls, and writeup (no product or model names).
